messages.subject: Deploying Shiny App with 3GB dataset
parts: Hi - firstly I should say I am not a developer (although I have tinkered with development in the past). I am a business guy who has a 3GB public dataset and using a small sample, my intermediate knowledge of R and Shiny was able to put together a simple yet interesting app. I would to like to deploy the app to the web for everyone but with the full dataset which is huge. Need some advice on how to do this please. My main concern is around how much memory a server would need given the way R works and the cost of that. Any advice appreciate. Thanks Rav

messages.author: 9711d30301c32133
messages.subject: Re: Deploying Shiny App with 3GB dataset
parts:
Hi. Check out the page in our tutorial on Scoping. It should be entirely possible to create a Shiny app around your large dataset by loading it only one time; then all your users' sessions would share that one object.

Jeff
